messages:
lina: Quick sync: proposing a compact ROW mode for Roles matrix + a non-modal SSO hint in the invite drawer. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-roles (Frames: Roles-compact, Invite-hint).

omar: Compact rows look good but keyboard targets shrink. If we go compact, keep interactive elements at 44px and increase focus outline. Also add a setting toggle so orgs can choose density.

yasmin: For SSO in invites: prefer an inline pill next to email that says 'SSO enforced' with an accessible tooltip. Avoid modal. Copy suggestion: 'Enforce Single Sign-On for new members — they will sign in with your identity provider.' Link to docs.

lina: Agree on pill. Dev note: client shows pill based on org.sso_enforced flag; server must re-check on invite send and return a clear 409 if policy changed. Show inline error on affected rows.

omar: Audit log filters: persist filters in URL + sticky bar on desktop. Use left rail only if we add saved presets. For back-button state, URL solves most issues.

yasmin: A11y checklist (short): role badges get aria-label with permissions summary, pill tooltip must be keyboard-focusable and persistent in DOM, slider toggles need labels and arrow support, aria-live for filter counts.

infra-bot: note: feature-flag rollout recommended. Add server-side check for invite policy and include inviter_id in audit events.

lina: Action items: Omar -> add focus outline + toggle in Figma; Yasmin -> finalize microcopy + a11y checklist; I'll open PR stub for server 409 handling and URL filter persistence. Posting to product crit for quick review.
